name: @typecrate/harness
description: Rust-native harness control plane: the canonical /v1/harness REST + stream server, ported from @underload/harness and discovered by @typecrate/services through *-route.rs files.
#identity: npm identity for the Rust crate at packages/typecrate/harness. Crate name == npm name with @ dropped and / replaced by - (rust/README.md name mapping); the crate version and this version line are pinned together and src/lib.rs asserts the crate constant matches. private: true because the artifact is a cargo build inside this repo, not a published package yet.
#layout: Rust-first and native-only: Cargo.toml is a standalone Cargo workspace (explicit [workspace] boundary so the root rust workspace stays untouched, the same shape packages/typecrate/services uses) with one lib plus the typecrate-harness-server bin. There is no wasm target here - the harness is a server with filesystem persistence. Artifacts land in the repo-root .rust/target because ../../../.cargo/config.toml sets target-dir; cargo picks that config up by walking up from this directory.
#rust: check / test / lint / build / start are plain cargo. `lint` denies warnings because nothing else in this repo runs a non-strict clippy for this crate yet; `verify` is the full gate (fmt:check + lint + test + release build of the server). `start` ends in a bare `--` so npm's own `--` separator forwards flags to the executable; the bin is a placeholder until the HTTP stage lands and prints a not-wired-yet note with exit 0.
#parity: Behavioural spec is packages/underload/harness/src (shared/harness-api.ts, shared/harness-stream.ts, shared/origin.ts, server/config.ts, server/api-paging.ts, server/api-events.ts, server/environment.ts, server/package-root.ts, server/protocol.ts, types/index.ts). Port decisions and every deliberate deviation are recorded in knowledge.md.

scripts.verify: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
